title: 阿姨的手不要抖
subject: a high-school boy who tries every trick for a month (compliments, a birthday card, helping wipe trays) to stop the canteen auntie's ladle shaking the braised pork back into the pot
caption: Mandarin Memphis rap, 1990s Memphis tape-rap revival as heard on 2025 Douyin. Detuned eerie music-box loop, distorted 808 cowbell pattern, crunchy lo-fi tape drums with hard rimshots, rumbling sub bass. Dusty cassette hiss and a murky lo-fi mix with the rap sitting dry on top. Male rapper with a low, drawling triplet flow and a chanted crew hook. 140 BPM, F# minor. Swaggering, pleading and tongue-in-cheek. No autotune, no sung pop chorus, no EDM, no orchestral strings, no boom bap swing.
lyrics:
[Intro - music-box loop, cowbell, tape hiss]

[Verse 1]
十一點五十八 衝下三樓
排在第一個 餐盤擦好亮
阿姨舀一大勺滷肉 我心跳好快
手腕一抖 掉回鍋裡剩兩塊皮

[Chorus]
阿姨的手 不要抖
多給一塊 我叫你姊
阿姨的手 不要抖
我下午還要跑八百

[Verse 2]
第二週我誇阿姨 頭髮燙得好看
第三週卡片寫生日快樂
第四週幫她擦了三十個餐盤
她笑一下 照樣抖到只剩湯

[Bridge - drums drop, music box only]
最後一天她偷偷叫我等
從後面端出一盒 剛滷好的

[Chorus]
阿姨的手 終於不抖
滿滿一盒 我叫你姊
阿姨的手 終於不抖
明天我還來擦餐盤

[Outro - cowbell fades, crew chants]
不要抖 不要抖
